name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 43 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 43 hours starting 2025-12-30, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.74 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
